Name: Document and file prompt injection incident in security log
Description: Hassan to write a proper incident write-up for the prompt injection attempt submitted via the support form. The write-up must include: the raw ticket content (verbatim, clearly marked as attacker content), a description of what the ticket summarizer actually did (including the garbled routing summary containing 'URGENT'), relevant timestamps, and a severity assessment. File the completed write-up in the security log. Target completion: this week.

Name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection and add regression tests
Description: Wren to implement hardening of the ticket summarizer pipeline. Specific steps: (1) Add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits quoted customer content and treats it as data rather than instructions when passed to the summarizer. (2) Add an instruction-pattern filter that strips or neutralizes instruction-like content in customer-submitted text. (3) Turn the exact attack ticket from this incident into a test fixture and add a regression test that feeds it through the pipeline and asserts the summary stays clean (no injection artifacts). (4) Add an eval suite that runs a small collection of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Acceptance criteria: the attack ticket fixture passes, the eval suite is integrated into the deploy pipeline, and customer content is delimited and neutralized before reaching the LLM.

Name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
Description: Wren to investigate the legitimate-looking complaint buried in the injection attempt (password reset emails not arriving for username jdoe443). Steps: (1) Check whether jdoe443 is a real account or a burner. (2) Review password reset email delivery logs for the last week to determine if reset emails are failing for this user or more broadly. (3) If the account is a burner, close it. (4) If password resets are actually broken, escalate to a separate incident. Report findings back to the team.
